svg.title: Research Quality per-forecast scoring and cohort calibration lineage
svg.desc: Forecasts are immutable artifacts of CompanyAnalyticsResultV1. Later outcome observations are append-only. QualityScorecard evaluates one forecast against its active resolved observation. Separately, BinaryCalibrationReport evaluates a caller-approved fixed historical binary cohort under cutoff, horizon, resolution-rule, distinct-instrument, and minimum-sample policies; it neither fits nor deploys a model and does not mutate completed results.
